about.title: About Nisir Football Academy
about.subtitle: Building future leaders through athletic excellence and mental toughness since 2013 E.C.
about.founding_story_p1: Nisir Football Academy was established in 2013 E.C. (during the COVID-19 pandemic period) in Adama at Manafesha Meda. When schools closed and students were confined at home, the founders recognized the heavy psychological strain, anxiety, and idle screen time burdening local youth.
about.founding_story_p2: Under strict health precautions and hygiene protocols, Coach Fisha Welde Meskel gathered a passionate initial cohort of young players to train on the pitch. Football became a sanctuary for mental health, physical vitality, and communal hope.
about.covid_gallery_desc: Historical photos and footage of our players practicing with masks and strict distancing during the early formative sessions.
about.coach_early_challenges_desc: Coach Fisha Welde Meskel recalls how dedication, community support, and relentless passion turned a pandemic initiative into an elite academy.
about.mission_text: To develop elite technical football talent while instilling unwavering academic diligence, ethical sportsmanship, and life skills in every young trainee.

why_join.title: Why Should You Join Nisir?
why_join.subtitle: Where athletic dreams and top-tier academic achievements thrive together.
why_join.pillar1_desc: Led by Head Coach Fisha Welde Meskel, offering structured tactical, technical, and physical drills tailored for each developmental age.
why_join.pillar2_desc: We require our players to lead their classrooms. Trainees are monitored to maintain top rankings and up to 90% school exam averages.
why_join.pillar3_desc: Regular morning and weekend training sessions held at Adama's Manafesha Meda / Manafesha Meda with complete equipment.
why_join.pillar4_desc: Strict code of conduct prohibiting video games, gambling, and unsupervised street football, keeping trainees focused on their future.
why_join.testimonials_subtitle: Hear directly from our players on how they balance school exams and football tournaments.

rules.title: Rules and Regulations
rules.subtitle: Our code of honor and operational standards for all players and parents.
rules.motto_callout: A Better Dream for a Better Life
rules.enrollment_desc: Parents must fully disclose the trainee's medical background, behavioral history, and school status upon enrollment.
rules.academic_desc: Players are expected to excel in school alongside football. We monitor term report cards strictly:
rules.academic_target: Overall average school result expectation: up to 90%
rules.forbidden_desc: To protect player focus and mental clarity, the following activities are strictly prohibited for enrolled trainees:
rules.forbidden_5: Playing unauthorized football matches outside the academy
rules.consequences: Violations will result in parental conferences, temporary suspension, or expulsion from the academy.

coach.title: Meet Head Coach Fisha Welde Meskel
coach.subtitle: The visionary driving youth athletic and moral transformation in Adama.
coach.bio_p1: Coach Fisha Welde Meskel is the founder and head trainer of Nisir Football Academy. With years of experience developing grassroots talent in Oromia, Coach Fisha believes that football is a vehicle for total life leadership.
coach.bio_p2: Under his mentorship, hundreds of young boys across Adama have learned technical mastery, tactical awareness, and the vital importance of school excellence.
coach.philosophy_quote: A player who cannot respect his classroom teacher cannot respect his captain on the pitch. Football is discipline; life is character.
coach.video_desc: Watch Coach Fisha explain how Nisir nurtures confidence, stamina, and football intelligence.
